## Parallel execution

v0.9.0 makes the runtime concurrent. A node with several outgoing direct edges fans out, its branches run at the same time, and the nodes they lead to join. Governance holds across the fan-out: one shared budget, an approval gate that pauses a single branch, and a checkpoint that carries the whole frontier.

**This release has breaking changes.** See the [migration guide](https://datallmhub.github.io/agentflow4j/migration-0.9/).

### Parallel branches
- **Fan-out and join.** Several direct edges out of a node are independent branches; a node reached by several branches runs once, after the last of them. `Builder.maxConcurrency(int)` bounds the branches in flight, default 4.
- **Deterministic state merge.** Branch updates are merged when the frontier completes. Two branches writing different values to the same `StateKey` raise `StateConflictException` instead of letting the finish order decide.
- **Partial approval.** An `ApprovalGate` pauses only the gated node: the other branches complete, their state is checkpointed, and the resume does not replay them. A join waits for the gated branch rather than reporting partial results.

### Rerun without repeating side effects
- `ResumeOptions.ofRejection(node, reason)` plus `Builder.onRejection(node, target)` send a rejected approval back into the graph instead of ending the run.
- The checkpoint carries a memo of completed nodes (`Checkpoint.completedNodes()`), so a rerun crossing them skips them and logs `NODE_SKIPPED`. `ResumeOptions.withInvalidated(node)` forces one to run again.
- Checkpoint format v3; v1 and v2 payloads are still read.

### Known limits
- A frontier is a barrier: the next one starts when every node of the current one has finished.
- `invokeStream` visits branches sequentially, since one ordered event stream cannot interleave concurrent nodes.

### Install (JitPack)
```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>com.github.datallmhub.agentflow4j</groupId>
    <artifactId>agentflow4j-starter</artifactId>
    <version>v0.9.0</version>
</dependency>
```
